properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 11 at 3:18PM CDT until September 11 at 6:15PM CDT by NWS Birmingham AL
properties.description:
FFWBMX

The National Weather Service in Birmingham has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Calhoun County in east central Alabama...
North Central Cleburne County in east central Alabama...

* Until 615 PM CDT.

* At 318 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2.5 and 3.5 inches of
rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Piedmont, Liberty Hill, Coleman Lake And Campground, Sweetwater
Lake and Oak Level.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 11 at 1:50PM MST until September 11 at 3:45PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
At 150 PM MST, local law enforcement reported flooding on Lone Pine
Dam Road north of Lindon. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain have
fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.25 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Show Low, Taylor, Schoens Lake, Linden, Ned Lake, Fool Hollow Lake,
Telephone Lake, Pintail Lake, Pinedale, Clay Springs, White
Mountain Lakes Estates, White Mountain Lake Estates and White
Mountain Lake Airport.

This includes the following highways...
State Route 260 between mile markers 322 and 336. State Route 77
between mile markers 343 and 351.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Fool Hollow Lake Recreation Area Campground.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Dodson Wash, Pinedale Wash, Linden Draw, Show Low Creek, Hog Wash,
Cottonwood Wash, Rocky Arroyo, Stinson Wash and Silver Creek.
properties.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable. Paved roads and underpasses could become
flooded as well.

Low water crossings will become dangerous in heavy rain. Do not
attempt to cross flooded roads. Find an alternate route.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 11 at 2:19PM MDT until September 11 at 5:15PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Kane County in southern Utah...

* Until 515 PM MDT.

* At 219 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across areas near Hole in the Rock Road, including
Zebra, Peekaboo, and Headless Hen Canyons, plus Coyote Gulch and
Forty Mile Gulch. Up to 0.5 inches of rain have fallen. Flash
flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks, streams, slot
canyons, and normally dry washes.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Areas near Hole in the Rock Road and the Escalante River, including
Zebra, Peekaboo, and Headless Hen Canyons, plus Coyote Gulch and
Forty Mile Gulch.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain. Dry
washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 5:15 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 5:15 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 11 at 4:12PM EDT until September 11 at 5:15PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
properties.description:
SMWMHX

The National Weather Service in Newport has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Neuse and Bay Rivers...

* Until 515 PM EDT.

* At 411 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located over The Vicinity Of Slocum Creek, or 12 nm
west of Oriental. The severe thunderstorm was nearly stationary.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
The Vicinity Of Hancock Creek, The Vicinity Of Slocum Creek, The
Vicinity Of Clubfoot Creek, and Mid Point Of Cherry
Branch-Minnesott Beach Ferry Terminal.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

* WHEN...From late Sunday night until further notice.

impassable.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 11 at 1:31PM MST until September 11 at 2:00PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
SVRFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...

* Until 200 PM MST.

* At 131 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located 7 miles south of
Manila, or 19 miles southeast of Winslow, moving east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Joseph City.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 40 between mile markers 273 and 281. Business Interstate
40 between mile markers 275 and 276.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm...
